visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged female with short dark hair, wearing round glasses and a sleeveless floral dress with white, orange, and blue patterns, sits on a couch in a brightly lit studio. She speaks directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures. A clinic logo is visible at the top. (2) The scene shifts to a macro close-up of a patient's neck being treated. A person in white medical gloves uses a white handheld medical device (Curejet) to inject substances into horizontal neck lines. Redness and small white bumps are visible on the skin. (3) A four-panel grid displays 'Before and After' photos of neck treatments, showing the improvement of skin texture and reduced lines. The female from phase one appears as an overlay in the bottom corner. (4) The female doctor returns to the full frame, explaining the recovery process. She points to her own neck to demonstrate. (5) Close-up photos of a neck with vertical red bruising/marks are shown, illustrating potential side effects like temporary pigmentation or bruising. (6) The video concludes with a clean white graphic background displaying the clinic's logo, social media handles (Line), telephone number, and two physical addresses in Taiwan.
